text:
Nora: did a focused a11y review of the Console dashboard (model list + run flyout) this morning. Not many blockers but a handful of medium/low nits we should fix before the next release.
Ken: awesome, drop the list and repros please.
Nora: TL;DR: 1) focus ring disappears in dark mode for small icon-only buttons, 2) several toggles use aria-pressed but are also input checkboxes (duplicate semantics -> SR reads twice), 3) flyout close button loses focus when closed via Esc (focus goes to body), 4) table headers use aria-label that duplicates visible text causing repeated reads, 5) status pill hover reduces contrast on condensed rows.
Priya: solid. can you add quick fixes for each so eng can estimate?
Nora: sure: (1) Focus ring: in dark theme we set `outline-color: transparent` for subtle look. Problem: 2px outline gets swallowed. Quick fix: use `box-shadow` fallback and `:focus-visible` to ensure 3px contrasty ring: ```css .icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } @media (prefers-contrast: high) { .icon-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.36); } }```
Ken: prefer stronger color. maybe use `rgba(0,120,212,0.9)` brand blue in dark mode so it stands out.
Nora: agree, brand blue works.
Nora: (2) toggles: current markup: `<button role="switch" aria-pressed="true">Toggle</button>` but the control is actually a `checkbox` input styled as switch. SR reads both role and input. Fix: use native `<input type=checkbox role="switch" aria-checked=...>` OR remove `aria-pressed`. Keep semantics single-source.
Sam: yes, prefer native input for keyboard semantics (space toggles) and less JS. Also add `aria-describedby` to explain persistent consequences for destructive toggles.
Priya: record that as medium effort since it touches many toggle instances.
Nora: (3) flyout close focus: repro: open row action > press Esc to close > focus lands on body. Expected: focus returns to the action trigger. Fix: call `trigger.focus()` in close handler; ensure close animation doesn't steal focus: set `aria-hidden` and move focus immediately, then run CSS exit. Example: ```js function closeFlyout(trigger){ flyout.classList.add('exiting'); trigger.focus(); requestAnimationFrame(()=> flyout.classList.remove('exiting')); }```
Ken: also add unit test that opens flyout, presses Escape, asserts document.activeElement === trigger.
Nora: (4) header ARIA duplication: headers have `<th aria-label="Status">Status</th>` which reads "Status Status" in some screen readers. Remove `aria-label` when visible text exists; reserve `aria-label` for icon-only headers.
Sam: good catch. Also check `aria-sort` usage on sortable headers; we should update only when sort state changes (avoid setting `aria-sort="none"` repeatedly).
Nora: (5) status pill contrast: in compact rows `.status-pill.small:hover { background: #303030; color: #bdbdbd; }` contrast drops < 3:1. Options: increase bg contrast or switch text to `#ffffff`. Proposed quick CSS: `.status-pill.small:hover { background: #252525; color: #ffffff; font-weight:600; }`
Priya: include color swatch and WCAG ratios in PR.
Nora: extras: keyboard shortcut collisions — `?` opens keyboard cheat sheet but in the table modal `?` is used by the editor plugin. Suggest scope shortcuts (only active when modal isn't focused) and add `aria-describedby` linking the shortcut hint to controls.
Ken: agree. We should implement `Mousetrap` scoping or a simple `document.activeElement` guard before shortcut handler runs.
accessibility-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2247007890 1 issues found: Focus-visible: FAIL on 7 elements (icon buttons), Contrast: WARN (status pill hover), ARIA: WARN (duplicated labels on headers), LiveRegions: INFO (no noisy live announcements detected).
Sam: plan: Nora + Ken to pair on quick CSS + JS fixes this sprint (skip refactor). Priya: can we scope toggles refactor next sprint?
Priya: yes. prioritize focus ring and flyout focus return this sprint. toggles and header cleanup next sprint. add checklist to card: https://redwood-infra/board/502.
Ken: I'll open a PR for focus ring + flyout fix today and include unit + e2e keyboard tests.
Nora: will prototype status pill swatches and toggles checklist.
Sam: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver on the PR and confirm duplicated header reads are gone.
Priya: thanks team 44c adding design review label and reassigning QA.
Nora: thx all — linking to screenshots and notes: https://redwood-infra/notes/a11y-2247007890 :sparkles:
